Color performance · whole entry, individual glyphs and independent backgrounds
Degrees apply to hue. Other channels use normalized native units. Ctrl/Cmd selection and typing remain host-owned; styles never replace glyphs or hit IDs. All additional bounds, per-character overrides, gradient stops, layers and triggers are editable below.
Property paths and deterministic triggers

Source samples are explicit values, not hardware readings. The example maps heat above 75 °C to a stronger screen blend. Trigger output is evaluated once, with rollback on invalid writes.

Palettes · 24 original color-mode studies

CMYK is an unprofiled display preview, not print color management. Indexed books are caller-owned tables; no proprietary Pantone database is bundled.

Complete configuration · every parameter is editable

Atomic validation: a rejected edit leaves the live style and draft unchanged. “rate” is sampled against the declared unit/tickMs. Boundary, easing, skip intervals, quantization and endpoint dwell can be combined. JSON is data, never code.

Implement this in TypeScript, Python, Go or Rust
High-level behavior is shared through the explicit Node bridge for native-language hosts. Native World/Studio APIs remain available without Node. The four complete framework applications are under apps/ in the SDK.

Logical ticks, presentation FPS and incoming data are independent. Hold motion, then type. Rebuilding a field never accepts test fixtures. Historical galleries and the full Field Guide are retained in the SDK.
